title: Handling of complaints
text:
Handling of complaints
Any entity with a legal interest in filing a complaint may file a formal complaint about matters associated with the activities of Euronext Securities Porto.
Euronext Securities have established transparent rules and procedures for the handling of complaints.
For further information please visit Euronext Securities website.
For clarification of questions:
ES-PTO_complaints@euronext.com
